title: Mod Bandit Matte Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Simpson Mod Bandit Matte Black combines flip-up modular convenience with highway touring comfort, delivering flip-up versatility for city stops and sealed protection at speed. Built around a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell weighing a solid 1666g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~86 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Round Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Modular version of the Bandit with full flip-up chin bar.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for a wide range of head shapes; the modular system allows for customization to fit specific needs. The Matte Black finish is non-reflective.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Simpson Mod Bandit Matte Black: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Simpson Mod Bandit Matte Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Simpson Mod Bandit Matte Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Round Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Simpson's Modular lineup, the Mod Bandit Matte Black brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for a Round Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Simpson Mod Bandit Matte Black represents Simpson's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~86 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Modular helmet tailored to a Round Oval head shape, the Simpson Mod Bandit Matte Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
